caption: The drawing features a long, elaborate gown on a faceless, headless mannequin figure, centered on the page. The main gown is cream-colored with an all-over floral pattern composed of pink, red, and yellow flowers with green stems and leaves. The gown has a fitted bodice and a wide, square neckline. The bodice includes blue-gray lace trim along the front edges and at the sleeve cuffs, which are gathered and voluminous. The skirt is full, draped, and gathered, with multiple visible folds, and the floral pattern continues throughout. The back of the gown includes an extended train, also heavily patterned. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified line sketch depicting the back view of the dress, showing the train's outline and the back construction in minimal detail without coloration or decoration. The drawing is rendered on cream paper.
title: Dress
